reasons.plausibility: Sound overall approach for strengthening BCC-based HEAs via Mo addition, though the precise dislocation mechanism shift (screw to edge) may need additional justification.
reasons.testability: Clear experimental steps with control (baseline) and test group, along with specific property and microstructural measurements, provide a direct means to falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Proposes a concrete and relevant strategy for enhancing high-temperature strength in HEAs for nuclear/aerospace applications.
